name: Gyre Therapeutics Cancel & Restore Incremental Merge
description: 将取消与恢复报表基表与本月增量按创建编号幂等合并，不在合并阶段按日期过滤，输出完整历史基表供下游按业务月份计算。

tasks.name: Extract Base Cancel & Restore Report
tasks.description: 读取上月合并后的完整取消与恢复基表。

tasks.name: Extract Incremental Cancel & Restore Report

params.emptyColumns: 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 员工邮箱, 手机号, 证件号, 在职状态, 授予编号, 激励类型, 所属计划, 授予日期, 授予数量, 授予价(USD), 创建日期(GMT+8), 创建编号, 归属日期, 财务变更日期, 变更日期, 变更类型, 取消/恢复原因, 数量, 归属规则, 操作人

tasks.description: 读取本月取消与恢复报表；报表可以是增量，也可以是重复导出的全量表。未提供该可选输入时输出带列契约的空 dataframe，由 base 独立成表。

tasks.name: Filter Incremental Rows To Workflow Month
tasks.description: 保留增量报表全部记录，不按日期截断；业务月份过滤只在下游 Plan Summary 指标计算中执行。

tasks.name: Merge Base And Increment Idempotently

params.failureMessage: Cancel & Restore base 缺少创建编号或变更日期字段
params.expectedColumns: 创建编号, 变更日期, 数量

params.failureMessage: Cancel & Restore 增量缺少创建编号或变更日期字段
params.expectedColumns: 创建编号, 变更日期, 数量

params.sql:
select
  case when i.[姓名] is not null and trim(cast(i.[姓名] as string)) <> '' then i.[姓名] else b.[姓名] end as [姓名],
  case when i.[工号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[工号] as string)) <> '' then i.[工号] else b.[工号] end as [工号],
  case when i.[牛牛号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[牛牛号] as string)) <> '' then i.[牛牛号] else b.[牛牛号] end as [牛牛号],
  case when i.[员工邮箱] is not null and trim(cast(i.[员工邮箱] as string)) <> '' then i.[员工邮箱] else b.[员工邮箱] end as [员工邮箱],
  case when i.[手机号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[手机号] as string)) <> '' then i.[手机号] else b.[手机号] end as [手机号],
  case when i.[证件号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[证件号] as string)) <> '' then i.[证件号] else b.[证件号] end as [证件号],
  case when i.[在职状态] is not null and trim(cast(i.[在职状态] as string)) <> '' then i.[在职状态] else b.[在职状态] end as [在职状态],
  case when i.[授予编号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[授予编号] as string)) <> '' then i.[授予编号] else b.[授予编号] end as [授予编号],
  case when i.[激励类型] is not null and trim(cast(i.[激励类型] as string)) <> '' then i.[激励类型] else b.[激励类型] end as [激励类型],
  case when i.[所属计划] is not null and trim(cast(i.[所属计划] as string)) <> '' then i.[所属计划] else b.[所属计划] end as [所属计划],
  case when i.[授予日期] is not null and trim(cast(i.[授予日期] as string)) <> '' then i.[授予日期] else b.[授予日期] end as [授予日期],
  case when i.[授予数量] is not null and trim(cast(i.[授予数量] as string)) <> '' then i.[授予数量] else b.[授予数量] end as [授予数量],
  case when i.[授予价(USD)] is not null and trim(cast(i.[授予价(USD)] as string)) <> '' then i.[授予价(USD)] else b.[授予价(USD)] end as [授予价(USD)],
  case when i.[创建日期(GMT+8)] is not null and trim(cast(i.[创建日期(GMT+8)] as string)) <> '' then i.[创建日期(GMT+8)] else b.[创建日期(GMT+8)] end as [创建日期(GMT+8)],
  case when i.[创建编号] is not null and trim(cast(i.[创建编号] as string)) <> '' then i.[创建编号] else b.[创建编号] end as [创建编号],
  case when i.[归属日期] is not null and trim(cast(i.[归属日期] as string)) <> '' then i.[归属日期] else b.[归属日期] end as [归属日期],
  case when i.[财务变更日期] is not null and trim(cast(i.[财务变更日期] as string)) <> '' then i.[财务变更日期] else b.[财务变更日期] end as [财务变更日期],
  case when i.[变更日期] is not null and trim(cast(i.[变更日期] as string)) <> '' then i.[变更日期] else b.[变更日期] end as [变更日期],
  case when i.[变更类型] is not null and trim(cast(i.[变更类型] as string)) <> '' then i.[变更类型] else b.[变更类型] end as [变更类型],
  case when i.[取消/恢复原因] is not null and trim(cast(i.[取消/恢复原因] as string)) <> '' then i.[取消/恢复原因] else b.[取消/恢复原因] end as [取消/恢复原因],
  case when i.[数量] is not null and trim(cast(i.[数量] as string)) <> '' then i.[数量] else b.[数量] end as [数量],
  case when i.[归属规则] is not null and trim(cast(i.[归属规则] as string)) <> '' then i.[归属规则] else b.[归属规则] end as [归属规则],
  case when i.[操作人] is not null and trim(cast(i.[操作人] as string)) <> '' then i.[操作人] else b.[操作人] end as [操作人]
from {base} b
full outer join {increment} i
  on upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[创建编号], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[创建编号], '') as string)))
where trim(cast(coalesce(b.[创建编号], i.[创建编号], '') as string)) <> ''
order by coalesce(b.[变更日期], i.[变更日期]), coalesce(b.[创建编号], i.[创建编号])

tasks.description: 按创建编号 full outer join 幂等合并；同一创建编号由增量覆盖，从而重复导入同一全量或增量文件不会重复累计。

tasks.name: Persist Merged Cancel & Restore Base
tasks.description: 输出截至业务月份的完整取消与恢复基表；下月作为 base 继续幂等合并。
